_about: 古七's boards (h11; the per-回 plan 2026-10-15, Wave 2 D): each the book's own action where its scene stands, every one skippable once stuck (the page's 算了，往下走), and each pays what the plan names — 修为 for cultivation (随叶, 禹步, 定风, 顺风溜), 灵石 / a thing for the rest (认方 a 聚气丹, 闻焦 and 芦苇 灵石). The two fights (灵草谷's 犰狳, 崖顶's 秦雁) are scene duels on their exits, paid there.
_economy: Pay declared here for the economy model (tools/balance.mjs reads tasks/*.json): the 修为 is +20 over 古七 from boards (jiuge-sui 5, jiuge-yubu 5, furnace-ding 5, xie-wind 5), +30 the 犰狳 (09-lingcao/fight, scene table) and +30 the 秦雁 bout (09-futian/spar, trial table, paid after the 七层 rise); 灵石 +3 (year-smell), +2 (yishui-reed), +20 (犰狳), +20 (秦雁); items: qi-pill (furnace-recipe), huochai-jian and shunfeng-liu (on the ways on). The three rises — 五层 (09-furnace/fire, and 09-year/futian as a catch-up), 六层 (09-yishui/night), 七层 (09-futian/spar, the 秦雁 bout's way on) — each wait on the 阶段任务: 圆满 of the layer held (caps.hui.h11.gates: [{layer 4, 09-furnace, [fire]}, {layer 4, 09-year, [futian]}, {layer 5, 09-yishui, [night]}, {layer 6, 09-futian, [spar]}]).

title.en: Feeding the Rice Bucket · Good riddance

done_line.zh: 一道红光窜出来，钉在了门板上，剑柄还在嗡嗡地颤。
done_line.en: A red light shot out and stuck fast in the door, the hilt still humming.

tasks._reward: What it makes (火柴, huochai-jian) is handed over by the way on (09-snow/feed's grant) — a story thing every later fight wears, so a skipped board still gives it.

title.en: Follow the leaf · Go with it

done_line.zh: 叶子正落在扫帚把尖上。「你得随它，跟着它走。」
done_line.en: The leaf lands right on the tip of the broom. "You have to go with it. Follow it."

title.en: The Step of Yu · Nine squares

tasks._reward: 修为 5, and the mark `yubu` either way (he walked it) — 古九's 量河滩 board reads it.

title.en: Reading the recipes · Three of them

done_line.en: Three recipes, kept in his belly.

tasks._reward: A 聚气丹 (qi-pill) — the plan's: a lesson, not cultivation.

title.en: Settle the wind · See it rise

done_line.zh: 他看见了它起来的那一下。
done_line.en: He has seen the moment it rose.

done_line.zh: 「丹师，这个……是不是就是丹焦的味儿？」
done_line.en: "Pill-master, this... is this the smell of a pill scorching?"

tasks._reward: 灵石 +3 — the 「丹房 · 看丹炉」 tablet's work (周衡: 看炉，记功).

how.zh: 往后拉，松手放剑，飞行中点一下，剑直冲出去。等它吸气，翅膀根翻开的那一霎。
how.en: Pull back and let go; tap in flight and the sword flies straight. Wait for its breath: the instant the wing root opens.

done_line.zh: 它叫了一声，翅膀张了一半，塌了下去。
done_line.en: It bellowed; the wings half opened and collapsed.

tasks._reward: 灵石 +2 — the book's split of the 四块 (「阿禾一块，孙二狗一块，他两块」); the hide and membrane are told (no item rows).

done_line.zh: 这双鞋，不是打架的，是跑的。
done_line.en: These shoes weren't for fighting. They were for running.

tasks._reward: 修为 5; the boots (shunfeng-liu) come with the way on (09-xie/go).
